intelligence.essence: Ten boards, about two minutes, for someone cold: chaos, nutshell, welcome, how it works, grandma, your worlds, your day, why it matters, what's in it for you, you're hired — visual with a little text alternating with complete text, sides swapping as you go. He handed over the visuals ("This is one set"), asked for the ultimate story distilled from them, and approved the order with "Yes. That's what I'm asking." The manifest — STORY-ORDER.md — is the source of truth. And the count that came with it is corrected in the same pass: the agreement holds 49 distinct images, not 100+.
